summary: Split at the sole full-height maroon(9) column, crop the nonzero template from the left panel, and scan the right board without rotations. A placement qualifies only when every template-zero cell covers board zero, every required nonzero cell is exact except for exactly one board zero, and there are no wrong-color cells. Fill that one missing required cell with its template value for every qualifying placement; preserve everything else.
